program.name: Obserra Website and Academy CMMC Level 2 Traceability
program.claimBoundary: Engineering alignment, evidence traceability, and audit readiness only. This register does not claim CMMC certification, a CMMC status in SPRS, FedRAMP authorization, FDACS approval, or authorization to process CUI.

cmmcLevel2CurrentRuleBaseline.ruleState: As of 2026-08-13, CMMC Phase II implementation is suspended while Phase I self assessment requirements remain. Current DoD Level 2 enforcement continues to reference the 110 requirements in NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 2.
cmmcLevel2CurrentRuleBaseline.crosswalkPurpose: NIST SP 800-171 Rev. 3 is the Obserra engineering baseline. Rev. 2 practice mappings are retained so the evidence package remains usable for the currently enforced CMMC Level 2 assessment baseline.

traceability.driftPolicy: CI fails if the source register is invalid, the NIST Rev. 3 catalog is incomplete, a mapped requirement is unknown, evidence references are missing, the generated Markdown differs, or the recorded SHA-256 digest differs.

scope.boundary: Public website, Obserra Academy and LMS, supporting GitHub backend, Supabase Academy database and Edge Functions, Clerk identity, Stripe commerce, Vercel runtime, and direct dependencies required by those components.
scope.excluded: Other Obserra applications and products not used by the website or Academy LMS workstream.

traceRecords.title: Default deny regulated mutation boundary
traceRecords.implementation: All Florida Class D write operations pass through a global regulated execution boundary before authentication. Unauthorized regulated writes fail closed.
traceRecords.gap: Formal CMMC assessment testing remains separate from source validation.

traceRecords.title: Clerk identity middleware and paid learner authorization
traceRecords.implementation: The website exports Clerk middleware directly and paid Academy media and tutor routes require authenticated identity and current entitlement in preview and production.
traceRecords.gap: Production verification, MFA policy, authenticator policy, and Clerk provider assurance remain required.

traceRecords.title: Preview authentication bypass removal
traceRecords.implementation: Generic Vercel preview authentication exceptions were removed from paid learner media and tutor endpoints so preview follows the production authorization model.
traceRecords.gap: Deployment verification remains part of release acceptance.

traceRecords.title: Public Academy catalog data minimization
traceRecords.implementation: The public catalog Edge Function is GET only, exposes a public field allowlist, returns only public visible controls, and omits hidden or unpublished records.
traceRecords.gap: Provider platform assurance remains external evidence.

traceRecords.title: Academy fail closed publication controls
traceRecords.implementation: Missing or malformed Academy course control data resolves to unpublished, invisible, and purchase disabled. The reviewed 60 course baseline is explicitly published by controlled migration.
traceRecords.gap: Operator approval procedures and formal configuration management policy require organizational evidence.

traceRecords.title: Supabase row level security and privileged function boundary
traceRecords.implementation: Reviewed Academy data tables use forced row level security with no anonymous or authenticated grants, while reviewed security definer functions are service role only with controlled search paths.
traceRecords.gap: Full database role inventory, provider assurance, backup controls, and periodic privilege review evidence remain required.

traceRecords.title: Stripe POST only checkout and same origin enforcement
traceRecords.implementation: Stripe Checkout Session creation is POST only, same origin protected, form content type restricted, current course authorization checked, and responses are no store.
traceRecords.gap: Production verification after deployment and Stripe provider assurance remain required.

traceRecords.title: Signed Stripe webhook and idempotent entitlement fulfillment
traceRecords.implementation: Payment fulfillment requires a Stripe signed webhook and a paid event, and entitlement creation is idempotent.
traceRecords.gap: Provider availability, webhook delivery assurance, and production event evidence remain external.

traceRecords.title: Verified purchaser identity for deferred course claims
traceRecords.implementation: Deferred paid course claims require exact user binding or a verified Clerk email matching the paid Stripe purchaser email. Unverified aliases cannot claim access.
traceRecords.gap: Provider identity proofing and email verification configuration require external evidence.

traceRecords.title: Audit ledger and regulated evidence preservation
traceRecords.implementation: Course publication and regulated operations retain audit events and controlled handoffs. Gate evidence is bound to exact source commits and retained as GitHub artifacts where implemented.
traceRecords.gap: Centralized log retention, immutable external archive, alert review cadence, and time synchronization evidence require completion.

traceRecords.title: Dependency vulnerability audit and flaw remediation
traceRecords.implementation: Production dependencies are locked and CI blocks high severity npm audit findings. Gate 32 remediated vulnerable transitive PostCSS and Sharp dependency paths through a targeted Next.js upgrade.
traceRecords.gap: Broader host, code, runtime, and provider vulnerability scanning coverage must be documented for the final CUI scope.

traceRecords.title: Deterministic build and dependency lock integrity
traceRecords.implementation: CI installs locked dependencies, verifies lock immutability, runs tests and lint, and builds the production application. Generated Next type drift is committed rather than ignored.
traceRecords.gap: SBOM retention, artifact signing, provenance attestation, and approved software inventory remain additional supply chain evidence targets.

traceRecords.title: Website browser and transport security headers
traceRecords.implementation: The website enforces CSP, framing protections, HSTS, MIME sniffing protection, cross origin protections, HTTPS upgrade, and no store handling on transactional routes.
traceRecords.gap: FIPS validated cryptographic module evidence and end to end storage encryption evidence remain required if the future CUI boundary includes these services.

traceRecords.title: Regulated migration manifest and database promotion binding
traceRecords.implementation: Gate 29 produces a deterministic regulated migration manifest and binds database promotion to the exact candidate SHA, latest migration version, and manifest digest.
traceRecords.gap: Production Class D database promotion is intentionally not authorized or performed.

traceRecords.title: Cryptographic HA evidence gate
traceRecords.implementation: Gate 31 requires a candidate bound cryptographic HA evidence manifest covering ten subsystems, per evidence digests, recency, RTO, RPO, and failover testing.
traceRecords.gap: Authentic Vercel, Clerk, Stripe, Daily, document storage, observability, backup and restore, and failover evidence remains incomplete.

traceRecords.title: Runtime monitoring and production telemetry review
traceRecords.implementation: Vercel runtime telemetry identified Clerk middleware failures and Academy degradation, and the findings were remediated in source rather than suppressed.
traceRecords.gap: Formal continuous monitoring strategy, alert routing, escalation, retention, and periodic review evidence remain required.

traceRecords.title: Course release identity and certificate payment parity
traceRecords.implementation: The reviewed Academy baseline has one authoritative release identity, version 1.0.0 and published status, consumed consistently by public API, Stripe metadata, and legacy certificate fallback.
traceRecords.gap: Formal release approval procedure remains organizational evidence.

traceRecords.title: GitHub change control and exact SHA validation
traceRecords.implementation: Material regulated changes are committed on a controlled branch, associated with PR 56, and accepted only after the exact SHA passes five mandatory workflows.
traceRecords.gap: Branch protection, administrator role review, signing policy, and organizational change approval evidence should be retained for formal assessment.

traceRecords.title: External service inventory and shared responsibility tracking
traceRecords.implementation: Controlled handoffs identify Vercel, Clerk, Supabase, Stripe, Daily, document storage, observability, and backup dependencies and record which evidence remains provider dependent.
traceRecords.gap: Formal service inventory, contracts, responsibility matrix, provider authorization evidence where required, and CUI flow approval remain incomplete.

traceRecords.title: Backup and restore evidence gap
traceRecords.implementation: Backup and restore is explicitly tracked as unresolved external evidence rather than assumed from provider capabilities.
traceRecords.boundary: Shared Obserra and data storage providers
traceRecords.gap: Authoritative backup configuration, encrypted backup evidence, recovery testing, retention, RPO, and RTO must be obtained.

traceRecords.title: CMMC and NIST traceability single source of truth
traceRecords.implementation: CMMC and NIST traceability is maintained in one machine readable source register. Human readable audit output and its digest are generated deterministically, and CI fails on schema, catalog, mapping, evidence reference, or generated document drift.
traceRecords.gap: The SSP and organization wide policies remain separate required assessment evidence and are not auto satisfied by this register.

openAuditGaps.title: Formal CUI scope and asset categorization
openAuditGaps.detail: Complete the authoritative CMMC Level 2 assessment boundary, asset inventory, network and data flow diagrams, and final asset categories before authorizing CUI.

openAuditGaps.title: System Security Plan and organization defined parameters
openAuditGaps.detail: Complete the SSP, policies, procedures, rules of behavior, and all applicable Rev. 3 organization defined parameters.

openAuditGaps.title: Provider assurance and shared responsibility
openAuditGaps.detail: Retain authoritative security and shared responsibility evidence for Vercel, Clerk, Supabase, Stripe, Daily, document storage, monitoring, and recovery services.

openAuditGaps.title: Backup, recovery, RPO, RTO, and failover evidence
openAuditGaps.detail: Obtain encrypted backup configuration, recovery test evidence, retention, RPO, RTO, and failover exercise evidence. Do not infer this from vendor marketing.

openAuditGaps.title: FIPS validated cryptography boundary if CUI is introduced
openAuditGaps.detail: Identify all cryptographic modules protecting CUI and retain evidence of applicable FIPS validation before CUI processing is authorized.

openAuditGaps.title: Organizational, personnel, training, media, physical, and incident evidence
openAuditGaps.detail: Collect and approve the non code evidence required by the final assessment scope.

openAuditGaps.title: Current CMMC Level 2 Rev. 2 assessment crosswalk completion
openAuditGaps.detail: Trace records include applicable Rev. 2 practice IDs. A complete formal 110 practice crosswalk must be reviewed against current DoD assessment artifacts before an assessment package is declared complete.
